basic_info.description: Luxurious 1BR Penthouse at Telegraph Landing with Iconic Views! Spacious and light-filled 1 bedroom, 1 bath penthouse featuring sweeping Bay and City views, including Alcatraz and the Bay Bridge. Highlights include a large living/dining area with wood-burning fireplace, galley kitchen with in-unit laundry, and an expansive bedroom with walk-in closet, balcony, and plenty of room for a home office. Deeded parking (P-66) and storage (S-43). Full-service building with 24-hour doorperson, gym, sauna, clubroom, roof deck, and on-site management. Prime North Waterfront location near the Embarcadero, Ferry Building, North Beach, and Pier 39. A must see!
